- write-mask (ABI v6): minimal = decode+drain one governed CSR bit + test -> completion = full governed set + skip-when-clear + engine-warning (+tests).

- docs/notebooks/skill: single commits (USER_GUIDE, FRS/MRD, CLAUDE.md, each notebook, the skill).

Intermediate trees need not match any historical tree but MUST build (make -C qemu_plugin / driver unit tests / make -C runtime / make -C tests/fixtures as applicable) and pass their own reduced tests.
